note: `build` is the human-readable stamp; `rev` is the machine-comparable one, and it is what the updater and the GitHub release tag (vN) agree on. rev 0 means "built from source, no release applied" — the release workflow stamps a real number, so don't hand-edit it. `updates` is filled in by setup/github-setup.sh. app/server.cjs reads this at startup and vite.config.ts bakes it into the front-end bundle, so Settings → System can show both. If those two ever disagree, the compiled dist/ is stale — run npm run build.
